description.value: Yokai Tapas is a Japanese fusion izakaya-style restaurant in Richmond specializing in small plates inspired by traditional Japanese small-dish culture, with a menu spanning yakitori, sushi, karaage, and wagyu beef. The sake program highlights premium Dassai Junmai Dai-Ginjo varieties from Yamaguchi, Japan alongside inventive plum-wine cocktails. Online ordering with in-restaurant pickup makes it a convenient stop for cyclists exploring the Richmond area.

bike_parking_detail: 4 racks within 100m: rack at 20m; rack at 56m; rack at 91m; rack at 96m.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website at yokaitapas.com is live and confirms the address (8133 Cook Rd #140, Richmond, BC V6Y 0L7) and phone (604-242-3808), both consistent with OSM. Takeout is confirmed via the explicit 'Order online and pickup in restaurant' call-to-action on the homepage. The OSM name 'Yoki Tapas & Sake Bar' appears to be a misspelling — the website consistently uses 'Yokai Tapas' — flagged in concerns; no cyclist-specific amenities (bike parking, Wi-Fi, charging, etc.) are mentioned anywhere on the site.
concerns: OSM name 'Yoki Tapas & Sake Bar' appears to be a misspelling — the business's own website consistently uses 'Yokai Tapas'. OSM record should be corrected to 'Yokai Tapas & Sake Bar'.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, active restaurant with a functioning website, confirmed address, and online ordering. No reason to exclude.

wow_evidence: Japanese fusion izakaya-style restaurant in Richmond
